item.title: 7. The Great Society Programs
item.description: Lyndon Johnson’s 1960s expansion of welfare and social programs significantly increased federal involvement in social services. Conservatives argue these programs fostered dependency and failed to eliminate poverty despite decades of spending.

item.title: 8. Biden’s Border Policies
item.description: Critics contend that enforcement decisions under the Biden administration contributed to record illegal crossings and strain on local and federal resources. The majority argue the policies incentivized unlawful migration and overwhelmed border infrastructure.

item.title: 9. DEI Mandates in Education and Government Agencies
item.description: Diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives expanded under the Biden administration are criticized by conservatives as promoting ideological agendas, increasing bureaucracy, and undermining merit-based standards.

item.title: 10. Men in Women’s Sports Policies
item.description: Policies allowing transgender athletes to compete in female sports categories have sparked national debate. Conservatives argue such policies undermine competitive fairness and conflict with the original intent of Title IX protections.
